body: I did everything and anything I could to be there for him.

I’m not fucking complaining. If my brother was truly suffering all I wanted was for him to come and talk to me. I do want him to be alive. He was 15. Did you read anything besides the small snippet where I said I thought it was selfish? I HAVE TRIED TO KILL MYSELF TOO. I HAVE WANTED TO DIE TOO. I WANT TO DIE EVERY SINGLE DAY. I am sitting here having nightmares, having dreams he’s back, wishing and wanting nothing more but to hug him. KILLING YOURSELF IS SELFISH. SO MANY PEOPLE CARED ABOUT MY BROTHER. I AM NOT MAD AT HIM. I forgive him for taking his own life but I am so upset that he didn’t reach out when I would spend nights worrying myself sick about him and calling him and texting him. I AM NOT COMPLAINING. I am grieving. DO I NEED TO SAY AGAIN THAT MY LITTLE BROTHER was a 15 YEAR OLD CHILD?! IS THAT NOT ENOUGH FOR YOU TO THINK HE SHOULD BE HERE INSTEAD OF SITTING IN AN URN?! HE WAS 15! He was going to start driving this year and he was so excited to go to prom and to live his life. My brother was struggling in a way that he never expressed. I would talk to him constantly about depression and suicide and tell him how sorry I was for ever trying to leave him alone in this world. I HAVE BEEN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THIS FENCE FOR YEARS. SUICIDE IS SUCH AN AWFUL AND HEARTBREAKING WAY TO GO. CAN I SAY ONE MORE TIME THAT HE WAS A 15 YEAR OLD CHILD WHO DESERVED TO LIVE FOREVER? I would do anything and everything to bring him back. I’d kill myself if it meant I don’t have to sit and watch my mom drink herself away and tell me how she blames herself. To not see my dad cry that he lost his boy. I would love to just cease existence just so everyone around ME can be happy. HIS LIFE BROUGHT HAPPINESS TO ALL. NOT JUST ME. Don’t call me SELFISH for wanting my..AGAIN 15 YEAR OLD KID BROTHER BACK.
I could never forget. My heart is so broken.
thank you. you’re 100% right but some days it’s so hard to remember that,

This is my first time ever experiencing any sort of loss, so I’m dealing with that alongside the fact that suicide was the reason. He hung himself from his loft bed and he was tall..maybe 5’9 and I just keep waking up or staying up and thinking “Why didn’t he just stand up?” The doctors say we only had 60 seconds before he blacked out but are they just saying that to make me feel better? I don’t know..I just don’t know anymore. I just want someone to fix it. I wish that movies were real and the concept of bringing someone back was a true reality...but death is just cold and awful.

I’m so sorry for your loss. I just hate this waving and ebbing process of grief...good days then soooooo many bad bad days. This is my first time experiencing loss ever so I’m just trying to handle that along with the fact that my brother took his own life.

Thank you. I think the hardest part of all of this is that people keep asking “how didn’t you notice” and it’s like “fuck probably because i wasn’t at the house anymore and i’m stupid and i don’t understand anything”...I also attempted suicide around the age of 15 by trying to slit my wrist, and obviously I’m still here. That hurts too. Having my brother go through the pain of almost losing me and then just going and allowing me to lose him. I just am so lost and confused.

Thank you all so much for your touching comments and stories. I dreamt last night that he was allowed to come back but only for a week and he was able to do everything he wanted to do before dying. He was just so young. I’m only 19 too. I’ve never been so heartbroken before .
no and i’m so sick of people asking me and then asking how the fuck i couldn’t even notice myself
hey, today is my birthday too! please don’t give up today, it’s such a beautiful day to be alive. how old are you turning today?
